design.order: Within each task, deterministically shuffle the full 96-cell plan with local RNG 6700+task_index; repeat index does not claim provider seed determinism.
design.packet_invariance: The canonical p66 packet JSON SHA256 is exactly identical across channel arms at each task/draw/vertex/semantic/alias. schema/json_object have byte-identical textual prompt; plain changes response envelope only.

treatment_definition.schema: P42 exact strict JSON schema response_format; P42 original JSON prompt.
treatment_definition.json_object: Provider json_object response_format; the exact same P42 original JSON prompt.
treatment_definition.plain: Unconstrained response_format; same underlying P66 packet and semantic task, but plain-text NONE or CHALLENGE|u1|different envelope instruction. Compound formatting+prompt treatment; cannot attribute this pairwise contrast solely to provider decoder.

estimands.primary_pilot: Executable correctness among ALL invocations, where provider failure or format invalidity is 0 for executable correctness but NOT imputed as semantic error.
secondary: Semantic correctness given format-observable response, flagged as selected
Paired packet-hash equality and raw error token class
estimands.no_confirmatory_inference: 384-call pilot is feasibility only. No p-value, novelty promotion, or published causal effect from pilot; full later preregistration requires held-out grammatical generalization.

pilot_measurement_gate: All 384 unique identities and 128/channel; each of the three channels must have >=96 provider responses (75%) to mark MEASUREMENT_FEASIBLE. Otherwise TECHNICAL_MEASUREMENT_HOLD, no adaptive reruns.
pre_frozen_risks: Groq can reject JSON schema with failed_generation NONE; represent technical failure separately.
Malformed JSON text and provider request rejection are distinct states.
p42_reopen.groq_raw does not send nominal seed, so P66 draws were stochastic invocation labels.
Validity and correctness tradeoff already in JSONSchemaBench and The Constraint Tax; no novelty on general format penalty.
P66 BH–BT missingness-free performance gap of at least 1105/1536 persists even if all missing truth assignments are favorable, so output formatting errors alone cannot explain that gap.
prohibitions: Do not change P66 frozen scientific result.
Do not alter pilot gate post execution.
No GitHub Actions bot commits or push rights.
No blanket causal conclusion from non-randomized historical P66 source.
